provenance.citation: Woodward A, Hashikawa T, Maeda M, et al. (2018) The Brain/MINDS 3D digital marmoset brain atlas. Scientific Data 5:180009. doi:10.1038/sdata.2018.9

processing: Source grid 678 × 1000 × 210 at 0.04 × 0.04 × 0.112 mm resampled to 0.12 mm isotropic for the browser (linear for images, nearest-neighbour for labels).
Region volumes are counted on the original source grid, not the resampled grid.
Display windows are the 0.5th–99.7th percentiles of labelled-brain voxels.
Meshes are marching-cubes surfaces of the resampled labels, decimated for display; they are not the atlas authors' surfaces.
